title: 20. How JAPAN became INVISIBLE without losing DOMINANCE w/ Ulrike Schaede

reader_summary.headline: Welcome to yet another episode of the Best Anchor's Talks Podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Welcome to yet another episode of the Best Anchor's Talks Podcast. I know it has been a while since the last episode. Today's guest definitely fits all what I look for. I had the pleasure to be joined by Ulrich Shade.

thesis: The podcast discusses the transition of Japan from a post-war developmental state that successfully caught up with the West to a niche economy following the burst of the early 1990s financial bubble. The host and guest explore how this shift, alongside trends in digitization and the labor market, has led to a situation where Japan is described as 'invisible' despite maintaining its economic dominance.
